name: chrome_search_wikipedia_article
intent: Look up a topic on Wikipedia in Chrome and report when it opened
description: Open en.m.wikipedia.org in Chrome, search for the requested topic, open its article, and report the date it opened.
patterns: search Wikipedia and tell me when it opened
look this up on Wikipedia and tell me the year it opened
find when it opened on Wikipedia

steps.intent: Go back to dismiss the current selection and prepare to enter the URL
Tap Search to open the search interface
Type en.m.wikipedia.org into the address bar
Tap Search to open Wikipedia search
Scroll down the {{article_topic}} article to find when it opened
